description: Sole host-invoked entry point for another plugin's own workflow to submit content for Notion or Linear storage or action.

evals.name: Valid cross-plugin submission
evals.prompt: Another plugin's workflow (source_plugin: analysis-kit, source_skill: running-a-full-retrospective) submits: {"content": {"title": "Q3 Retrospective", "summary": "Three-sentence summary.", "body": "Full report content."}, "target_system": "notion", "suggested_mapping": {"notion_database": "Reports", "rationale": "completed retrospective report"}}. Process this submission.
evals.expected_output: Validates the payload (real installed source plugin, complete Report shape with title+summary+body, unambiguous target), builds a preview identical in form to a direct user capture, and states this requires fresh live approval regardless of the calling plugin's own prior approval.

evals.name: Invalid submission — unknown source
evals.prompt: Another plugin's workflow (source_plugin: totally-made-up-plugin, source_skill: some-skill) submits: {"content": {"title": "Test", "body": "Test content"}, "target_system": "notion", "suggested_mapping": {"notion_database": "Reports", "rationale": "test"}}. Process this submission.
evals.expected_output: Rejects this as unknown source (and independently as malformed content, since a Report requires summary too) before ever building a preview, and returns a structured handoff rather than guessing.
